story_type: spy plane landing guided by a chase car on the runway
hook: This spy plane can't land without a car racing behind it.
narration: This spy plane is touching down, and a car is racing down the runway right behind it.
The U-2 Dragon Lady flies so high its pilot wears a pressure suit, and that suit limits how far the pilot can move and see.
So a former U-2 pilot drives a chase car under the landing jet.
Over the radio, the driver becomes a second pair of eyes and ears for the pilot.
The U-2 balances on two main wheels under its body. Small outrigger wheels called pogos drop away on takeoff.
So when it stops, a wingtip settles onto the runway, and the ground crew runs out to put the pogos back in.
outcome: The U-2 landed safely, the crew fitted its pogos, and the chase car followed it off the runway.
title: U-2 spy plane lands with a chase car
description:
Chase car drivers from the 99th Expeditionary Reconnaissance Squadron guide U-2 Dragon Lady pilots through landings at an undisclosed location in Southwest Asia, Dec. 22, 2015.

Footage: U.S. Air Force video by Capt. Joseph Simms, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/444885/dancing-with-dragon-chasers-tale
